hero.description: Raah and AssetSnip are tools we design, build, and grow in-house. Shipping our own products keeps us close to what developers actually go through, and that is what we bring to every devtool we work with.

dock.nextTagline: Something new is on the workbench

why.aside: Built in-house by the Studio1 team
why.title: Shipping our own tools makes us better at <accent>launching yours</accent>.
why.description: We sit on both sides of a launch. What we learn building Raah and AssetSnip goes straight into the docs, videos, and campaigns we make for devtool teams.

friction.title: We hit the friction first
friction.body: Setup steps, unclear errors, missing docs. We run into them on our own products, so we know where to look on yours.

launches.title: We run launches, not just plan them
launches.body: Landing pages, demo videos, changelogs, and community posts. Every launch of our own sharpens the playbook we run for clients.

builders.title: Content from people who build
builders.body: We write about devtools as builders, so tutorials and docs come from real use of the product, not a feature list.

why.playbook: Get the same playbook for your product

next.title: Product 03 is on the workbench.
next.description: Our next product is an AI SaaS tool, built the same way as Raah and AssetSnip. We will share more as soon as it is ready for real users.
